enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: Summons lightning on struck targets during storms.
enchantment.minecraft.lunge.desc: Launches user forward on spear jab attacks.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc: Launches user in water or rain.
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc: Creates launching wind on mace smash.
enchantment.enchantplus.armor/fury.desc: Decreases armor in percent and grants armor penetration and increased damage percentage on your hits.
enchantment.enchantplus.axe/timber.desc: Cuts down a tree with one strike.
enchantment.enchantplus.boots/lava_walke: Allows the player to walk on lava.
enchantment.enchantplus.boots/step_assis: Allows you to walk up blocks more easily.
enchantment.enchantplus.bow/breezing_arr: Causes a repulsion effect that sends the target into the air. If arrows miss, it creates a repulsion effect on the ground.
enchantment.enchantplus.bow/echo_shot.de: Creates an echo effect with arrows.
enchantment.enchantplus.bow/explosive_ar: Creates an explosion on impact with a block; entities take damage.
Creates a storm effect with arrows.
enchantment.enchantplus.chestplate/build: Allows you to place and break blocks from a longer distance.
enchantment.enchantplus.elytra/armored.d: Reduces the damage taken while using elytra.
enchantment.enchantplus.helmet/bright_vi: Gives night vision to the player.
If you fall into the void, you briefly gain a levitation effect.
enchantment.enchantplus.hoe/scyther.desc: Allows you to transform dirt into farmland in x by z surface depending on enchantment levels.
enchantment.enchantplus.leggings/dwarfed: Decreases entity size with additional negative effects.
enchantment.enchantplus.leggings/fast_sw: Grants the player a dolphin Grace effect.
enchantment.enchantplus.mace/striker.des: Has a small chance to summon thunder. During storms, each hit strikes the target and activates lightning rods. Grants immunity to thunder damage.
enchantment.enchantplus.mace/wind_propul: Causes an explosion that sends you into the air when striking the ground, designed to be used with "Wind Burst".
enchantment.enchantplus.pickaxe/bedrock_: Allows you to break bedrock but consumes 150 durability per block.
enchantment.enchantplus.pickaxe/spawner_: Allows your pickaxe to retrieve spawners.
enchantment.enchantplus.pickaxe/vein_min: If you break a mineral block, all surrounding minerals also break.
enchantment.enchantplus.sword/fear.desc: When you hit a creeper, increases the delay of their explosion by 12.5 seconds.
enchantment.enchantplus.sword/life_steal: Drains health from the target and transfers it to the player.
enchantment.enchantplus.sword/poison_asp: Poisons the mob upon hitting it.
enchantment.enchantplus.sword/pull.desc: Allows you to retrieve a mob egg with a small probability when you kill a monster.
enchantment.enchantplus.sword/reach.desc: Increases the range of your attack.
enchantment.enchantplus.sword/xp_boost.d: Increases experience gain when using tools.
enchantment.enchantplus.tools/auto_smelt: When the player breaks a block, the block will be automatically smelted.
enchantment.enchantplus.bow/eternal_fros: Ice-infused shots for bows and crossbows, creating ice effects on impact.
enchantment.enchantplus.bow/rebound.desc: Arrows bounce to nearby targets after hitting an entity.
enchantment.enchantplus.durability/curse: Increases durability consumption on each use.
Locks the item, preventing any enchanting or disenchanting.
enchantment.enchantplus.mace/teluric_wav: Creates sismic waves when striking the ground while crouching.
Consumes the item to inflict infinite damage on the target.
enchantment.enchantplus.trident/gungnir_: Transforms water into ice on impact and slows targets.
enchantment.enchantplus.sword/critical.d: Grants a chance to ignore part of the target armor.
enchantment.enchantplus.chestplate/magne: Automatically collects nearby items within a 10-block radius while worn.
enchantment.enchantplus.mounted/velocity: Grants a speed boost to the mounted pet.
